titles.native: 運動器検診マニュアル対応体操

description:
A short video illustrating different stretching postures and movements for skeletal-muscular screening purposes.

The video was produced by Oshuku Onsen Hospital and uploaded to YouTube. The single video collects two versions of the same animation: one with voiced instructions by a male and one by a female.
